headline: Use FaceTime on Android or Windows
standfirst: You do not need an Apple device to jump on a FaceTime call anymore.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: You can now join FaceTime calls from Android phones or Windows computers.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Apple opened up the service, allowing non-Apple users to connect via a browser link.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: It breaks down the walled garden, making it easier to chat with friends on any device.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Note that this is not the full experience, just a way to join existing calls.

caption:
How to join a FaceTime call on Android or Windows devices.

FaceTime is no longer limited to Apple hardware. While you cannot host a call from these devices, you can easily jump into one using a web link. It is a simple way to stay connected without needing an iPhone.

Does this make you more likely to use FaceTime, or do you prefer other apps?
